description: This file defines the UserTranslateProfileForm class, which is a form processor for translating user profile information such as 'name' and 'about'. It creates form fields and handles saving form data, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: UserTranslateProfileForm
classes.description: A form processor class for translating user profile fields, enabling creation and saving of translation forms for user data such as name and about section.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with 'name' and 'about' fields, configured according to user data and form options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data into the user model, handling errors such as invalid forms or save failures.
